entities.summary: Tyrone Bobby Joe Hill was an American basketball player and was the leading scorer of the 1965–66 Texas Western College team, helping the Miners win the 1966 NCAA basketball championship. The victory is considered one of the most important wins in American sports history – Texas Western started an all-black starting lineup, against the all-white University of Kentucky.
